name: Daan Gene Co., Ltd.
summary: Daan Gene Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches and develops, manufactures, and sells clinical test reagents, instruments, and supporting consumables in China. It operates through two segments, Biological Products and Related Business and Financial Business. The company offers PCR testing kits, including hepatitis virus, human papillomavirus (HPV), sexually transmitted infections sexually transmitted infections, human immunodeficiency virus, blood screening, respiratory infections, digestive pathogens, public health, coronavirus disease (COVID-19), tumor marker, pharmacogenomics, nucleic acid extraction, and viral transport medium (VTM) collection kits.
